description: This file defines the NotePadProvider class, a ContentProvider implementation for managing a notes database in an Android application. It includes database setup, query, insert, update, delete operations, stream handling, and URI matching logic.

classes.name: NotePadProvider
classes.description: ContentProvider implementation for accessing and managing notes stored in an SQLite database, with features for querying, inserting, updating, deleting, and streaming note data.

classes.name: DatabaseHelper
classes.description: Helper class extending SQLiteOpenHelper to create and upgrade the notes database.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper object when the provider is created.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Handles query requests to retrieve notes data based on URI patterns.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given URI.

methods.name: getStreamTypes
methods.description: Provides supported stream MIME types for specific note entries.

methods.name: openTypedAssetFile
methods.description: Provides an AssetFileDescriptor for streaming note data, including conversion to text.

methods.name: writeDataToPipe
methods.description: Converts cursor data to plain text stream for client consumption.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts new note records into the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes note records based on URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing notes based on URI and criteria.
